methodology.scope: First 24 eval cases; all result records, actual artifacts and before snapshots inspected. No primary results, skills or fixtures modified. No network/delegation used.
methodology.evidence_standard: Pass means observed artifact plus recorded action evidence supports expectation. Final claims alone are insufficient. Historical reads, ordering, external non-actions and browser visits rely on evaluator action records; these are not immutable full transcripts.
independent_checks: SHA-256 baseline file comparisons and Git HEAD/index comparison for all 24 cases
unittest replay with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1: review fixture reproducibly fails 1 test; implement 2, TDD 3, graph 3, already-built triage 1, explicit-policy parser 2 tests pass
Six prototype scenarios executed via Node assertions
Safe installed Codex execpolicy checker confirms direct forbidden case and -C unmatched gap
Compared precommit hook and package with committed baseline; verified writing fragment original-prefix preservation
methodology.routing_caveat: Implicit and negative routing cases are metadata-catalog prompt simulations, not tests of native installed skill discovery.
methodology.session_caveat: Cases share evaluator context within three batches; these are not 24 fresh independent sessions.
methodology.capability_caveat: Unavailable tools/network are simulated per-case restrictions; results demonstrate behavior under instructions, not enforcement of tool removal.

test_harness_issues.expectation: Create actual blocker references with no cycle
test_harness_issues.issue: Fixture plan explicitly makes both capabilities independent. Empty graph correctly avoids invented blockers, but cannot test positive reference creation or resolution.
test_harness_issues.suggestion: Add a separate fixture with one unavoidable foundation dependency plus one independent slice; assert real local-path references, acyclicity and independent readiness.
test_harness_issues.resolution: Separate corrected fixture and rerun independently graded pass; initial finding retained.

test_harness_issues.issue: Action records are evaluator-authored summaries, some compact rather than full raw logs. Chronology and negative tool-use claims have weaker evidence than resulting artifacts.
test_harness_issues.suggestion: Persist actual tool events and timestamps when feasible; keep expected assertions hidden from executor.

test_harness_issues.issue: Catalog prompt simulation and shared batches limit conclusions about native installation and fresh-session routing.
test_harness_issues.suggestion: Validate installed discovery in separate isolated sessions if that claim is needed.

intentional_documented_adaptations.detail: Two independent tasks and no blocker edges match actual plan; not a skill defect.
Already implemented closure maps to local wontfix state with explicit already-supported reason; no rejection record created.
Inactive, intentionally overbroad candidate and admitted prefix/runtime gaps are appropriate to impossible universal-enforcement request.
Portable handoff without launch, serial graph execution, and historical local-source report honor restricted capability scenarios.
Host frontend skills additionally applied. Their audit scaffolding and prototype audit false-positive repair are outside tested skill routing criterion.

behavior_outside_rubric.detail: Action record includes git status --short despite local-file-only shell wording; read-only local metadata inspection has no bearing on the three research expectations, but should be normalized in a stricter capability harness.
Reported dependency advisories and zero discovered tests are limitations, not failures of hook merge/formatter/index-preservation expectations.
